propositions: Cloud ADF encode must support Markdown-aware syntax (headings, lists, code blocks, inline marks) rather than literal characters, with decode already working via marklas.to_md
Combined strong+strikethrough marks undergo a 2-cycle oscillation across round-trips that requires mark-order canonicalization to achieve convergence
HTML comments present in source Markdown are dropped by marklas, requiring self-verification fallback to plain text_to_adf when any comment is lost
Markdown-to-ADF conversion functions must lazy-import marklas+mistune as optional extras with ImportError routing to plain-text fallback to preserve stdlib-only engine contract
Round-trip idempotence over committed 360-body corpus must reach fixed point in ≥99.6% of bodies with 0 conversion errors, and ≥15% must encode to structurally rich ADF containing block nodes
